metadata.title: Ransomware & eCrime catalog: the major criminal crews, their signature attacks, and the crypto rails
metadata.frame: Batch 2 of the threat-actor catalog: financially-motivated criminal groups (mostly Russia-based / Russia-tolerated) running Ransomware-as-a-Service and big-game hunting. Wired to signature victims (Colonial Pipeline, JBS, Kaseya, MOVEit, Change Healthcare, MGM), the crypto payment rails, law-enforcement takedowns, and the Malware_Lineage hub. Distinct from state APTs (espionage) and commercial spyware.
metadata.grade: Crew->attack->victim links, ransom amounts, sanctions, and takedowns = FACT (DOJ/OFAC/NCA actions; company disclosures; Chainalysis). 'Based in Russia' / state tolerance = well-established but an inference from geography + non-prosecution, not always a formal finding. RaaS 'groups' are fluid affiliate networks that rebrand (Conti->Black Basta/Royal; ALPHV/LockBit affiliates -> RansomHub).
metadata.honest_limits: RaaS is a franchise: the 'group' (operator) and its 'affiliates' (who actually break in) are separable, so attribution of a specific intrusion to a brand is really attribution to whoever used the kit. Rebrands and exit-scams (ALPHV faked its own takedown after the $22M Change Healthcare payment) blur continuity. Amounts paid are as-disclosed/reported; some are estimates.
metadata.method: DOJ indictments/seizures (DarkSide/Colonial clawback; REvil; LockBit Operation Cronos 2024); OFAC designations (Evil Corp 2019; others); NCA; company 8-Ks/disclosures (UnitedHealth/Change Healthcare, MGM, Caesars); Chainalysis crypto-crime reports; the 2022 Conti Leaks.

edges.notes: Conti (successor to Ryuk; Wizard Spider) - Russia-based; the 2022 'Conti Leaks' exposed its corporate-style org after it declared support for Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Later fragmented into Black Basta / Royal / Zeon (fact; Russia base well-established).
Ryuk (2018-20, big-game hunting via TrickBot/Emotet) is Conti's direct predecessor - same operators (fact).
Ryuk pioneered 'big-game hunting' (targeting large orgs for 7-8 figure ransoms) - the model the whole RaaS industry adopted (fact of influence).
REvil (Sodinokibi; GandCrab lineage) - Russia-based RaaS; the FSB announced arrests in Jan-2022 (later stalled). Ran Kaseya + JBS (fact).
Jul-2021: REvil exploited a Kaseya VSA zero-day to push ransomware through MSPs to ~1,500 downstream businesses - a supply-chain ransomware event; a universal decryptor later obtained (fact).
May-2021: REvil hit JBS (world's largest meatpacker); JBS paid ~$11M in Bitcoin - a food-supply-chain shock (fact).

May-2021: DarkSide ransomware shut Colonial Pipeline (largest US fuel pipeline), triggering East-Coast fuel panic; Colonial paid ~$4.4M in BTC; DOJ clawed back ~$2.3M. The incident that made ransomware a national-security issue (fact).
DarkSide - Russia-based RaaS that (notably) coded in an exclusion for CIS-country victims; went dark after Colonial, rebranded (BlackMatter) (fact/inference).
DOJ's ~$2.3M Bitcoin clawback from the Colonial ransom (via the FBI's key seizure) was a landmark - showing crypto ransoms are traceable/seizable (fact).
LockBit - the most prolific RaaS (2019-2024), Russia-linked; disrupted by NCA/FBI/Europol 'Operation Cronos' (Feb-2024, infrastructure seized, affiliate data exposed) but attempted to persist (fact).
Operation Cronos (NCA-led, DOJ/FBI/Europol) seized LockBit infrastructure, decryption keys, and unmasked affiliates - the model takedown, though the brand tried to reconstitute (fact).
LockBit's affiliate-friendly RaaS + fastest-encryptor marketing made it the dominant brand of the early-2020s ransomware economy (fact of scale).
May-2023: Cl0p (TA505-linked) mass-exploited a MOVEit Transfer zero-day, hitting 2,700+ organizations and ~95M individuals - the archetype of zero-day-driven mass data-theft extortion (fact).
Cl0p / TA505 - Russian-speaking; specializes in file-transfer zero-days (Accellion FTA, GoAnywhere, MOVEit) for pure data-extortion (often skipping encryption) (fact/inference).

Feb-2024: BlackCat/ALPHV (Rust-based RaaS) hit Change Healthcare, paralyzing US medical claims for weeks; UnitedHealth paid ~$22M - after which ALPHV EXIT-SCAMMED its own affiliate and faked a takedown (fact).
Change Healthcare is a UnitedHealth (Optum) subsidiary - so the breach hit a chokepoint routing a huge share of US healthcare claims (fact); wires the eCrime layer to the existing UnitedHealth node.
ALPHV/BlackCat - Russia-linked RaaS, likely DarkSide/BlackMatter successors; ran the notable MGM/Caesars affiliate ops via Scattered Spider (fact/inference).

Sep-2023: Scattered Spider (native-English social-engineering crew, tied to 'The Com') breached MGM Resorts (days of casino outages) and Caesars (which paid ~$15M) - deploying ALPHV ransomware. Notable for English-speaking, help-desk-vishing TTPs (fact).
Scattered Spider operated as an ALPHV AFFILIATE - illustrating the RaaS split: Western social-engineering access-brokers renting Russian ransomware (fact).
RansomHub (2024 RaaS that absorbed ALPHV/LockBit affiliates after the takedowns) deploys EDRKillShifter - linking the eCrime layer to the BYOVD/EDR-subversion block (fact).
RansomHub represents post-takedown consolidation - affiliates migrating to whichever brand survives law-enforcement pressure (fact of dynamic).

FIN7 / Carbanak (Cobalt) stole an estimated $1B+ from banks/retail/hospitality via the Carbanak backdoor (2013-18); later pivoted to ransomware affiliation (BlackCat) + selling tooling - eCrime's most durable enterprise (fact).
Carbanak proved organized financial-cybercrime at industrial scale - the professionalized-eCrime template that RaaS later franchised (fact of influence).
Evil Corp (Maksim Yakubets; Dridex/BitPaymer/WastedLocker) - Russia-based, with reported FSB ties; OFAC-sanctioned 2019; 2024 UK/US/AU sanctions + a named LockBit-affiliate link (fact).
Evil Corp's OFAC designation made paying its ransoms a sanctions violation - the policy lever that reshaped the ransom-payment/insurance calculus (fact).

Ransomware runs on crypto rails - ransoms paid in Bitcoin (increasingly with mixers/Monero) then laundered via exchanges/mixers; the payment layer that makes the RaaS economy work (fact of mechanism).
Blockchain-analytics firms (Chainalysis, TRM) trace ransom flows - enabling seizures (Colonial clawback) and the annual ransomware-payment tallies; the counter-force to the crypto ransom rail (fact).
Analytics firms feed law-enforcement/OFAC attribution + sanctions enforcement on crypto addresses - wiring the eCrime layer to the sanctions/regulator thread (fact).
